title: Power Ranger Season 20 Megaforce
description: When Earth is under attack by the evil Warstar aliens, the teenage Power Rangers take it upon themselves to fight them and save the planet.

episodes_data.title: Power Ranger Megaforce 20x1
episodes_data.description: When malicious aliens make their way to Earth's orbit, Gosei decides to form a new team of teenage heroes to defend the planet and carry on the proud tradition of the Power Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Ranger Megaforce 20x2
episodes_data.description: The alien invaders send Scaraba, an alien scientist, down to Earth to study the human race. Meanwhile, Troy finds himself face-to-face with Creepox.

episodes_data.title: Power Ranger Megaforce 20x3
episodes_data.description: When Noah has trouble lifting Jake's heavy weapon, he begins to doubt his abilities, until he learns that believing in yourself is all that's necessary to get any job done.

episodes_data.title: Power Ranger Megaforce 20x4
episodes_data.description: As the Rangers learn that concentration is essential to perfecting their Ranger skills, they are distracted by a civilian falsely claiming to be a Ranger.

episodes_data.title: Power Ranger Megaforce 20x5
episodes_data.description: Best Friends Gia and Emma are turned into bitter enemies by a vicious monster, Beezara. Meanwhile, the guys are captured by Beezara and turned into her slaves.

episodes_data.title: Power Ranger Megaforce 20x6
episodes_data.description: When Dizchord attacks the city with music that produces physical pain, the Rangers must fight back in an unorthodox way with a song of their own.

episodes_data.title: Power Ranger Megaforce 20x7
episodes_data.description: After Troy deals with some small-minded bullies at school, the Rangers square off against a more dangerous bully, Creepox.

episodes_data.title: Power Ranger Megaforce 20x8
episodes_data.description: The mysterious Robo Knight joins the Power Rangers. Can he help them defeat toxic monsters that threaten the Earth?

episodes_data.title: Power Ranger Megaforce 20x9
episodes_data.description: While the Rangers are unsure about how to work with the newly-arrived Robo Knight, Vrak captures the robotic Ranger in an attempt to reprogram him for his own nefarious purposes.

episodes_data.title: Power Ranger Megaforce 20x10
episodes_data.description: When a shadow-stealing monster attacks, the Rangers must teach Robo Knight the power of teamwork in order to defeat him.

episodes_data.title: Power Ranger Megaforce 20x11
episodes_data.description: The Megaforce Rangers must find a powerful ancient weapon called the Wild Sword in the Black Mountains. Vrak plans to get to the sword first where he enlist the help of Distractor.

episodes_data.title: Power Ranger Megaforce 20x12
episodes_data.description: Gia, Emma, Troy, and Jake are captured by Nojoke during his capture of laughing people. Noah and Robo Knight must overcome their differences to free the captive Rangers and defeat Nojoke.

episodes_data.title: Power Ranger Megaforce 20x13
episodes_data.description: A dream-eating monster called Dream Snatcher preys on Emma after being enhanced by the Aurora Box that belonged to Vrak's family. The Rangers and Robo Knight must rescue Emma's dreams and defeat Dream Snatcher before the Roots of Despair emitted from his victims rot the Earth.

episodes_data.title: Power Ranger Megaforce 20x14
episodes_data.description: Gosei and the Rangers must work together to defeat Bluefur and Bigs when they use the power of the Aurora Box.

episodes_data.title: Power Ranger Megaforce 20x15
episodes_data.description: The Rangers have a strange encounter with a medium on Halloween.

episodes_data.title: Power Ranger Megaforce 20x16
episodes_data.description: The Megaforce Rangers encounter their first Robotic opponents, who try to convince Robo Knight that humans are the true danger to the Earth.

episodes_data.title: Power Ranger Megaforce 20x17
episodes_data.description: When one of Metal Alice's robots malfunctions, Emma and the Power Rangers decide to adopt it and teach it the values of friendship and freedom.

episodes_data.title: Power Ranger Megaforce 20x18
episodes_data.description: The Megaforce Rangers must race to save the day when Metal Alice plots to throw the city into chaos by derailing a passenger train. Meanwhile, Robo Knight comes closer to understanding humans when he meets a young boy.

episodes_data.title: Power Ranger Megaforce 20x19
episodes_data.description: Admiral Malkor awakens from his cocoon stronger than ever and determined to destroy the Megaforce Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Ranger Megaforce 20x20
episodes_data.description: The Megaforce Rangers' victory over the Warstar aliens is short-lived when they discover Metal Alice has turned Vrak into a powerful and menacing cyborg.

episodes_data.title: Power Ranger Megaforce 20x21
episodes_data.description: When Cyborg Vrak, Metal Alice and The Messenger launch a vicious attack against the Megaforce Rangers, it will take all their powers and abilities to save the earth.

episodes_data.title: Power Ranger Megaforce 20x22
episodes_data.description: Robo Knight learns the true meaning of Christmas from a group of children when he is mistaken for a donated Christmas toy and is shipped in a charity crate to a foreign land.
